implementation.name: NES (MiST)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 49 HDL source files (21 systemverilog, 7 verilog, 21 vhdl). There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not MRA-setname-derived -- a MiST console core ships no MRA file. The core reimplements the NES and the Famicom, giving machine_id nes and machine_id famicom, each checked against extract/machine.json. License: the grant in https://github.com/mist-devel/nes/blob/master/mist/sdram.sv offers the work under the GNU General Public License "either version 3 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" (the repository has no LICENSE file) -- hence GPL-3.0-or-later. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 49 source files (21 systemverilog, 7 verilog, 21 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify. Platform: the compiled core is distributed through mist-devel/mist-binaries, whose cores/ directory is the MiST core set.
